risk_if_not_implemented: Without Release Owner Gate (ROG) For AI-Augmented Content, AI and autonomous technology risks may go ungoverned, leading to unintended outcomes, misuse, or data exposure.

compensating_control_1.name: Dual Approval For High-Impact Environments
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to require dual approval for any changes that might result in a serious incident that could adversely impact:
(1) Business processes; and/or
(2) Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_1.justification: Dual Approval For High-Impact Environments (CHG-08) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Release Owner Gate (ROG) For AI-Augmented Content (AAT-33) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to assign one or more qualified individuals with the mission and resources to centrally-manage, coordinate, develop, implement and maintain an enterprise-wide Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).
compensating_control_2.justification: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities (GOV-04) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Release Owner Gate (ROG) For AI-Augmented Content (AAT-33) by ensuring the organization can restore operations when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
